notes: Pinned original scripts; deterministic random data, time and captured controls.
Camera damping settles before image comparison. Jelly releases the brush and updates the camera before a fresh ray and 60 GPU simulation steps.
Selective Bloom click/toggle-back and MRT rotation pause/resume are compared.
GPU workload records include presentation and background passes. Three.js uses a 5952-index background sphere where Rust uses a fullscreen quad/triangle.
Native point draw(500000,1) and draw(1,500000) evaluate the same 500000 point vertices.
Warm-up visits the measured visibility state before rewinding and advancing; cold visible-object uploads are not steady-state animation transfers.
4160-byte skin/morph palette uploads are CPU bone-matrix updates, not CPU vertex skinning.
Several Rust postprocessed scenes retain an extra fullscreen presentation pass; these API counts are not a hardware timing-parity measurement.
